title: Exuberancy
summary: EXU'BERANCY, n. [L. exuberans, exubero; ex and ubero, to fatten; uber, a pap or breast, that is, a swelling or mass.] 1. An abundance; an overflowing quantity; richness; as an exuberance of fertility

inlines.v: EXU'BERANCY, n. [L. exuberans, exubero; ex and ubero, to fatten; uber, a pap or breast, that is, a swelling or mass.] 1. An abundance; an overflowing quantity; richness; as an exuberance of fertility or fancy.2. Superfluous abundance; luxuriance.3. Overgrowth; superfluous shoots, as of trees.
